package lintpolicy

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestRequestCookiesCarryOnlyNameValue(t *testing.T) {
	plain := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "https://cookie.example.test/", nil)
	plain.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: "fixture"}) // G124_REQUEST_ONLY
	profile := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "https://cookie.example.test/", nil)
	profile.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: "fixture", Secure: true, HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode})
	if plain.Header.Get("Cookie") != "session=fixture" || profile.Header.Get("Cookie") != plain.Header.Get("Cookie") {
		t.Fatal("response attributes changed request Cookie encoding")
	}
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	http.SetCookie(response, &http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: "fixture"}) // G124_TEST_RESPONSE
	if len(response.Result().Cookies()) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("missing response-cookie analyzer control")
	}
}
